<mentioned>

<mentioned> marks words or phrases mentioned, not used.
Attributes Global attributes and those inherited from hqphrase
Example 
There is thus a striking accentual difference between a verbal
form like <mentioned id="c234" lang="el">eluthemen</mentioned>
   <gloss target="c234">we were released,</gloss> accented on
the second syllable of the word, and its
participial derivative <mentioned id="c235" lang="el">lutheis</mentioned>
   <gloss target="c235">released,</gloss> accented on the last.
Module Declared in file teicore2; Core tag sets: enabled when any TEI base is enabled
Class hqphrase
Data Description free prose
